from pagination import paginate


def test_page_two_size_two_returns_third_and_fourth():
    result = paginate(range(1, 8), 2, 2)
    assert result == [3, 4]
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_page_one_size_two_returns_first_two():
    result = paginate(range(1, 8), 1, 2)
    assert result == [1, 2]
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_last_partial_page_returns_remaining_item():
    result = paginate(range(1, 8), 4, 2)
    assert result == [7]
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_page_beyond_last_page_returns_empty_list():
    result = paginate(range(1, 8), 5, 2)
    assert result == []
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_empty_input_returns_empty_list():
    result = paginate([], 1, 2)
    assert result == []
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_non_positive_page_returns_empty_list():
    result = paginate([1, 2], 0, 2)
    assert result == []
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_non_positive_page_size_returns_empty_list():
    result = paginate([1, 2], 1, 0)
    assert result == []
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_negative_page_and_size_return_empty_list():
    assert paginate([1, 2, 3], -1, 2) == []
    assert paginate([1, 2, 3], 1, -2) == []


def test_one_based_semantics_with_other_sizes():
    assert paginate(range(1, 8), 1, 3) == [1, 2, 3]
    assert paginate(range(1, 8), 2, 3) == [4, 5, 6]
    assert paginate(range(1, 8), 3, 3) == [7]
    assert paginate(range(1, 8), 4, 3) == []

patches.rationale: The original paginate used zero-based indexing (start = page * page_size), so page=2 returned range(3,5) as a range object. The issue requires one-based page numbers: page 2 size 2 on range(1,8) must return [3,4]. Fix start to (page - 1) * page_size. Also, slicing a range returns a range, not a list; the issue's expected values are lists ([3,4], [1,2], [7], []), so convert the slice result to a list. Empty/invalid inputs still return [] (already a list). Beyond-last-page slices yield an empty range, which list() converts to []. Add a new regression test file covering all acceptance contracts with exact input expressions and result types.
